CompatibleFunctions.toFunctionDistances.statement: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be an RCLike field (i.e. $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$), $X$ a pseudometric space and $A$ a natural number. Every `CompatibleFunctions` $\mathbb{K}$ $X$ $A$ structure on $X$ yields (as its underlying parent structure) a `FunctionDistances` $\mathbb{K}$ $X$ structure on $X$.
